title: EmailSubmission/queryChanges ignores filter and sort
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs handle_email_submission_query_changes passes None/None for filter and sort to backend.query_changes::<EmailSubmission>, so a filtered EmailSubmission/queryChanges returns the unfiltered delta and never validates the filter (RFC 8620 §5.6: filter/sort are those of the original /query). Same defect as JMAP-kyjz (Mailbox); fix by decoding filter with jmap_server::filter_arg and sort as EmailSubmission/query does, and forward both. Found while working JMAP-kyjz.
notes: Sort half fixed by JMAP-skk9.15 (submission_sort_arg forwarded to query_changes). Filter half remains. JMAP-skk9.18 is a duplicate.
close_reason: sort fixed in e4f3ae63 (skk9.15), filter fixed in 4dd3c8be (skk9.18)
